faqs.question: What languages are your tours conducted in?
faqs.answer: All safaris are conducted in English. Bus tours include a default English-speaking bilingual guide — German, French, Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Korean or Russian — depending on the scheduled language.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Bus tours and safaris may be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start of the tour.

faqs.question: Where do tours start and finish?
faqs.answer: All tours start and finish at hotels in the UAE.

faqs.question: Do you offer private tours?
faqs.answer: Yes — every tour and safari in our catalogue can also be booked privately.

faqs.question: Is there a children's price?
faqs.answer: Where a special children's price applies it is stated in the tour description, for children aged 2–12 unless other age groups are specified.

faqs.question: Are your vehicles safe?
faqs.answer: All off-road vehicles are fitted with seat belts and air-conditioning and are licensed to carry six people plus the driver.

faqs.question: Do all tours run year-round?
faqs.answer: Due to local climatic conditions, some tours and safaris do not run during the summer months.
